stem: The statutory body established under the Competition Act, 2002 to prevent practices having an adverse effect on competition, promote fair competition, and protect consumer interests in Indian markets (e.g., checking monopolies and anti-competitive mergers) is the:

options.option_text: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

explanation: The CCI regulates market competition and curbs monopolistic/anti-competitive practices under the Competition Act, 2002 — distinct from SEBI (securities markets regulator) or the CCPA (consumer-rights enforcement under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019).
